text_en: When the Canaanite, the king of Arad, who lived in the Negeb, heard that Israel was coming by the way of Atharim, he fought against Israel and took some of them captive.
text_cn: 客纳罕人的阿辣得王，其时住在乃革布，听说以色列人沿阿塔陵路前来，就与以色列人交战，掳去了一些人。

text_en: Then Israel made a vow to the Lord and said, “If you will indeed give this people into our hands, then we will utterly destroy their towns. ”
text_cn: 以色列人于是向上主许愿说：“你若将这人民交在我手内，我必将他们的城毁灭。”

text_en: The Lord listened to the voice of Israel, and handed over the Canaanites; and they utterly destroyed them and their towns; so the place was called Hormah.
text_cn: 上主遂听了以色列人的请求，将客纳罕人交在他们手里，以色列人就毁灭了他们和他们的城；人遂给那地方起名叫曷尔玛。

text_en: From Mount Hor they set out by the way to the Red Sea, to go around the land of Edom; but the people became impatient on the way.
text_cn: 他们由曷尔山沿红海的路起程出发， 绕过厄东地；在路上人民已不耐烦，

text_en: The people spoke against God and against Moses, “Why have you brought us up out of Egypt to die in the wilderness? For there is no food and no water, and we detest this miserable food. ”
text_cn: 抱怨天主和梅瑟说：“你们为什么领我们由埃及上来死在旷野？这里没有粮食，又没有水，我们对这轻淡的食物已感厌恶。”

text_en: Then the Lord sent poisonous serpents among the people, and they bit the people, so that many Israelites died.
text_cn: 上主遂打发火蛇到人民中来，咬死了许多以色列人。

text_en: The people came to Moses and said, “We have sinned by speaking against the Lord and against you; pray to the Lord to take away the serpents from us. ” So Moses prayed for the people.
text_cn: 人民于是来到梅瑟前说：“我们犯了罪，抱怨了上主和你；请你转求上主，给我们赶走这些蛇。”梅瑟遂为人民转求。

text_en: And the Lord said to Moses, “Make a poisonous serpent, and set it on a pole; and everyone who is bitten shall look at it and live. ”
text_cn: 上主对梅瑟说：“你做一条火蛇，悬在木竿上；凡是被咬的，一瞻仰它，必得生存。”

text_en: So Moses made a serpent of bronze, and put it upon a pole; and whenever a serpent bit someone, that person would look at the serpent of bronze and live.
text_cn: 梅瑟遂做了一条铜蛇，悬在木竿上；那被蛇咬了的人，一瞻仰铜蛇，就保存了生命。

text_en: The Israelites set out, and camped in Oboth.
text_cn: 以色列子民再起程出发，在敖波特扎了营；

text_en: They set out from Oboth, and camped at Iye-abarim, in the wilderness bordering Moab toward the sunrise.
text_cn: 由敖波特又出发，在依耶阿巴陵，即在面朝摩阿布东边的旷野内扎了营。

text_en: From there they set out, and camped in the Wadi Zered.
text_cn: 由那里又出发，在则勒得河旁扎了营。

text_en: From there they set out, and camped on the other side of the Arnon, in the wilderness that extends from the boundary of the Amorites; for the Arnon is the boundary of Moab, between Moab and the Amorites.
text_cn: 由那里又出发，在阿尔农北岸扎了营。这条河是在旷野中，由阿摩黎人的边境流出；阿尔农就是摩阿布的边界，介于摩阿布和阿摩黎之间。

text_en: Wherefore it is said in the Book of the Wars of the Lord , “Waheb in Suphah and the wadis. The Arnon
text_cn: 为此在“上主的战书”上说“……在稣法的瓦赫布和阿尔农山谷，

text_en: and the slopes of the wadis that extend to the seat of Ar, and lie along the border of Moab. ”
text_cn: 以及山谷的斜坡；这斜坡伸展到阿尔地区，紧靠摩阿布的边境。”

text_en: From there they continued to Beer; that is the well of which the Lord said to Moses, “Gather the people together, and I will give them water. ”
text_cn: 由那里他们到了贝尔，那里有口井，上主曾指这井对梅瑟说：“你召集人民，我要赐给他们水喝。”

text_en: Then Israel sang this song: “Spring up, O well! —Sing to it! —
text_cn: 那时以色列人就唱了这首歌说：“井，涌出水来！你们应对它歌唱！

text_en: the well that the leaders sank, that the nobles of the people dug, with the scepter, with the staff. ” From the wilderness to Mattanah,
text_cn: 这井是领袖挖掘的，是民间的贵人，以权杖和棍棒挖凿的。”他们由旷野到玛塔纳；

text_en: from Mattanah to Nahaliel, from Nahaliel to Bamoth,
text_cn: 由玛塔纳到了纳哈里耳；由纳哈里耳到了巴摩特；

text_en: and from Bamoth to the valley lying in the region of Moab by the top of Pisgah that overlooks the wasteland.
text_cn: 由巴摩特到了摩阿布田野的山谷，到了俯瞰荒野的丕斯加高峰。

text_en: Then Israel sent messengers to King Sihon of the Amorites, saying,
text_cn: 以色列人派遣使者到阿摩黎人的君王息红前说：

text_en: “Let me pass through your land; we will not turn aside into field or vineyard; we will not drink the water of any well; we will go by the King’s Highway until we have passed through your territory. ”
text_cn: “请让我由你国内经过；我们决不闯入庄田或葡萄园，也不喝井中的水，只沿王道而行，直至走过你的国境。”

text_en: But Sihon would not allow Israel to pass through his territory. Sihon gathered all his people together, and went out against Israel to the wilderness; he came to Jahaz, and fought against Israel.
text_cn: 息红却不让以色列人经过他的国境；且调集自己所有的人民，往旷野里去对抗以色列人；一来到雅哈兹，就与以色列交战。

text_en: Israel put him to the sword, and took possession of his land from the Arnon to the Jabbok, as far as to the Ammonites; for the boundary of the Ammonites was strong.
text_cn: 以色列人用刀剑将他击败，占领了他的国境，自阿尔农河直到雅波克河，直到阿孟子民那里，因为雅则尔是阿孟子民的边界。

text_en: Israel took all these towns, and Israel settled in all the towns of the Amorites, in Heshbon, and in all its villages.
text_cn: 如此以色列人占领了那里所有的城镇，就住在阿摩黎人所有的城镇内，并住在赫市朋及其附属城内。

text_en: For Heshbon was the city of King Sihon of the Amorites, who had fought against the former king of Moab and captured all his land as far as the Arnon.
text_cn: 赫市朋原是阿摩黎人王息红的都城。息红与前任摩阿布王交战，占领了他所有的土地，直到阿尔农河。

text_en: Therefore the ballad singers say, “Come to Heshbon, let it be built; let the city of Sihon be established.
text_cn: 为此诗人吟咏说：“你们到修建巩固的赫市朋去，那稳固的息红城；

text_en: For fire came out from Heshbon, flame from the city of Sihon. It devoured Ar of Moab, and swallowed up the heights of the Arnon.
text_cn: 因为由赫市朋发出了火，从息红的城冒出了火焰，吞灭了摩阿布的阿尔，消灭了阿尔农的高丘。

text_en: Woe to you, O Moab! You are undone, O people of Chemosh! He has made his sons fugitives, and his daughters captives, to an Amorite king, Sihon.
text_cn: 祸哉，摩阿布！革摩士的人民，你已灭亡！他的儿子已逃亡，女儿已被俘，交给了阿摩黎人的君王息红。

text_en: So their posterity perished from Heshbon to Dibon, and we laid waste until fire spread to Medeba. ”
text_cn: 但我们一袭击他们，赫市朋直到狄朋，尽成废墟；我们蹂躏一切……直到诺法黑，直到默德巴。”

text_en: Thus Israel settled in the land of the Amorites.
text_cn: 这样以色列人就住在阿摩黎人的区域内。

text_en: Moses sent to spy out Jazer; and they captured its villages, and dispossessed the Amorites who were there.
text_cn: 梅瑟又派人去侦探雅则尔；他们占领了这城及其附属城镇，驱逐了那里的阿摩黎人。

text_en: Then they turned and went up the road to Bashan; and King Og of Bashan came out against them, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.
text_cn: 以后前进，上了往巴商的路。巴商王敖格同他全国的人民，就出来对抗他们，在厄德勒与他们交战。

text_en: But the Lord said to Moses, “Do not be afraid of him; for I have given him into your hand, with all his people, and all his land. You shall do to him as you did to King Sihon of the Amorites, who ruled in Heshbon. ”
text_cn: 上主对梅瑟说：“不必怕他，因为我已将他，他的一切人民和国土，都交在你手里了；你要待他，如同对待住在赫市朋的阿摩黎人的君王息红一样。”

text_en: So they killed him, his sons, and all his people, until there was no survivor left; and they took possession of his land.
text_cn: 他们击杀了他，他的儿子和他所有的人民，没有剩下一个；遂占据了他的国土。
